source(output(
		RUN_DATE as timestamp 'ect.format.datetime.hypen.4year2month2day2hour24mmnute2secondsdot6nanoseconds',
		BATCH_ID as double,
		GRGR_ID as string,
		GRGR_NAME as string,
		SBSB_ID as string,
		SBSP_EFF_DT as string,
		ELIG_TYPE as string,
		AID_CAT as string,
		ERR_MSG as string,
		SYSTEM_UPDATED as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> InputPlaceHolderAUDITSRC	source(output(
		GRGR_ID as string,
		GRGR_NAME as string,
		SBSB_ID as string,
		BGBG_ID as string,
		BGBG_NAME as string,
		SBSP_EFF_DT as string,
		ELIG_TYPE as string,
		AID_CAT as string,
		ERR_MSG as string,
		CURRENT_DATE as timestamp,
		BATCH_ID as string,
		SYSTEM_UPDATED as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'select * from AGP.BILLING_AUDIT',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> AUDITLKPLKPTABLE
InputPlaceHolderAUDITSRC,AUDITLKPLKPTABLE lookup(InputPlaceHolderAUDITSRC@SBSP_EFF_DT == AUDITLKPLKPTABLE@SBSP_EFF_DT && InputPlaceHolderAUDITSRC@SYSTEM_UPDATED == AUDITLKPLKPTABLE@SYSTEM_UPDATED && InputPlaceHolderAUDITSRC@AID_CAT == AUDITLKPLKPTABLE@AID_CAT && InputPlaceHolderAUDITSRC@GRGR_ID == AUDITLKPLKPTABLE@GRGR_ID && InputPlaceHolderAUDITSRC@GRGR_NAME == AUDITLKPLKPTABLE@GRGR_NAME && InputPlaceHolderAUDITSRC@ELIG_TYPE == AUDITLKPLKPTABLE@ELIG_TYPE && InputPlaceHolderAUDITSRC@SBSB_ID == AUDITLKPLKPTABLE@SBSB_ID && InputPlaceHolderAUDITSRC@ERR_MSG == AUDITLKPLKPTABLE@ERR_MSG,
	multiple: false,
	pickup: 'any',
	broadcast: 'none')~> AUDITLKP
AUDITLKP select(mapColumn(
		RUN_DATE = RUN_DATE,
		BATCH_ID = AUDITSRC@BATCH_ID,
		GRGR_ID = AUDITSRC@GRGR_ID,
		GRGR_NAME = AUDITSRC@GRGR_NAME,
		SBSB_ID = AUDITSRC@SBSB_ID,
		SBSP_EFF_DT = AUDITSRC@SBSP_EFF_DT,
		ELIG_TYPE = AUDITSRC@ELIG_TYPE,
		AID_CAT = AUDITSRC@AID_CAT,
		ERR_MSG = AUDITSRC@ERR_MSG,
		SYSTEM_UPDATED = AUDITSRC@SYSTEM_UPDATED,
		BGBG_ID = BGBG_ID,
		BGBG_NAME = BGBG_NAME,
		CURRENT_DATE = CURRENT_DATE
	),
	 skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	 skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true) ~> AUDITLKPSelect
AUDITLKPSelect split(isMatch(), disjoint: true) ~> AUDITLKPIsMatch@(Match,NotMatch)
AUDITLKPIsMatch@Match sink(input(
		SBSB_ID as string,
		RUN_DATE as timestamp 'ect.format.datetime.hypen.4year2month2day2hour24mmnute2secondsdot6nanoseconds',
		BATCH_ID as double,
		GRGR_ID as string,
		GRGR_NAME as string,
		SBSP_EFF_DT as string,
		ELIG_TYPE as string,
		AID_CAT as string,
		ERR_MSG as string,
		SYSTEM_UPDATED as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	mapColumn(
		SBSB_ID,
		RUN_DATE,
		BATCH_ID,
		GRGR_ID,
		GRGR_NAME,
		SBSP_EFF_DT,
		ELIG_TYPE,
		AID_CAT,
		ERR_MSG,
		SYSTEM_UPDATED)) ~> OutputPlaceHolderMATCHOP
AUDITLKPIsMatch@NotMatch sink(input(
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	mapColumn()) ~> OutputPlaceHolderNOMATCHOP
